character: Purpose-built ski-in/ski-out satellite of Courchevel (created 1991). Handy position between Courchevel (6km) and Méribel (8km). Family-friendly, car-free centre. Good for intermediate access to both sides of 3 Vallées. Ski schools, daycare, beginner areas.
dining: Ski-in restaurants, piste-side dining, village restaurants. Selection of 5-6 good restaurants.
shopping: Small supermarket, bakery, sports rental, ski shops, pharmacy. Minimalist but sufficient.
apres_scene: Relaxed, family-oriented. Wooden cabin bars. Taïga cocktail bar. La Tania Pub (live music nights).
activities_nearby: Ski-in/ski-out to 3 Vallées. Snowshoeing, hiking, sledging. Free bus to Courchevel 1850 (6km). Ice skating in Courchevel.
